query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) = 0 THEN '0小時（同一時間）'
    WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 1 THEN '1小時內'
    WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 6 THEN '1-6小時'
    WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 24 THEN '6-24小時（跨天）'
    WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 48 THEN '24-48小時（2天）'
    ELSE '48-72小時（3天）'
  END as time_diff_bucket,
  COUNT(*) as pair_count
FROM priceHistory p1
JOIN priceHistory p2 ON (
  p1.id < p2.id
  AND p1.cardId = p2.cardId
  AND p1.source = 'snkrdunk'
  AND p1.jpyPrice = p2.jpyPrice
  AND COALESCE(p1.grade, '') = COALESCE(p2.grade, '')
  AND p1.sourcePosition = p2.sourcePosition
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 72
)
GROUP BY time_diff_bucket
ORDER BY pair_count DESC;
